name: webhexup.com
body: Every external link that was checked answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 16 internal links lead to an error.
lesson: Check your own links after each release, and fix or redirect every one that answers 404.
summary: www.webhexup.com scores 77 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 18 are at risk, and 36 pass. Fix first: 16 internal links lead to an error.

fix.title: 16 internal links lead to an error
fix.evidence: /contacto/ answered 404, linked from /, /seo/ and 4 more. /seo/ answered 404, linked from /. /seo-geo-ai/ answered 404, linked from /, /contacto/ and 4 more. /seo-tecnico/ answered 404, linked from /, /contacto/ and 4 more. /seo-local/ answered 404, linked…
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 12 elements on /, for example .wn-srv__row:nth-child(1) > .wn-srv__n and a[data-wn-srv="0"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (1 request), and cookies _gcl_au.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

works.title: Every external link that was checked answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 365 ms
The sitemap matches the pages that were analyzed
